ntranslator.open_browser.prompt: For NEXEL to transcribe your speech in Browser Transcription mode, your browser must stay open on the local page. You can close it once you stop using NEXEL.
ntranslator.request_download:
NEXEL wants to download a LibreTranslate instance to run locally on your computer. The download runs in the background so you can keep playing, but it may use part of your bandwidth.

This download only happens §lonce§r, and §lno LibreTranslate updates will be installed§r unless you delete the .nexel folder in your Minecraft folder.

The local LibreTranslate instance only runs while Minecraft is open. If it does not close afterwards, please report it on the CurseForge page.

This local instance helps reduce translation delay as much as possible.

If you want to disable it, turn it off in the NEXEL config.
ntranslator.request_download.deny.desc: If you deny the download, the "Should Run Translation Server" config option will be disabled automatically. You can turn it back on later from the NEXEL config menu.
ntranslator.transcriber.disconnected: Disconnected from Browser Transcription. Click here to reconnect.
ntranslator.transcriber.error.too_many_r: Too many transcriber resets have occurred within a small timeframe, please restart your browser!
ntranslator.transcriber.error.no_support: Your browser doesn't support the Web Speech Recognition API! Please try using Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge instead.
ntranslator.transcriber.type.sphinx.desc: Uses the PocketSphinx speech recognition engine for speech transcription. Currently disabled due to its large size requirement.
ntranslator.transcriber.type.browser.des:
Uses the Web Speech API for speech transcription. This requires opening your web browser to use it, and may use more resources.

Mainly supports Google Chrome and Microsoft Edge.
ntranslator.transcriber.type.windows_sap: Uses the Windows Speech API for speech transcription. This is natively supported in Windows, but requires you to install the language packs for the languages you intend to speak. Currently disabled due to requiring some research to set it up properly.

config.ntranslator.client.enabled.desc: Toggles whether the mod is enabled or disabled.

config.ntranslator.client.subtitleLangua: Selects the language used by speech bubbles.
config.ntranslator.client.muteTranscript: Mute Transcript when Voice Chat Muted?
If Simple Voice Chat / Plasmo Voice is muted and this option is enabled, NEXEL will not transcribe audio while you are muted.
config.ntranslator.client.openBrowserWit: When you join a world for the first time in a session, NEXEL will open the browser page automatically without asking first.
config.ntranslator.client.textScale.desc: The scale of the text inside the transcript boxes.
config.ntranslator.client.disappearingTe: When this is enabled, transcripts will disappear after they are finished being spoken, following the text delay.
The amount of time after a transcript is spoken until the text disappears.
The fade-out time of a disappearing transcript text.
config.ntranslator.common.preferEdgeBrow: Select Edge to open the transcription page secretly through the C# app. Leave Edge and Chrome unchecked to open the normal default browser.
config.ntranslator.common.preferChromeBr: Select Chrome to open the transcription page secretly through the C# app. Leave Edge and Chrome unchecked to open the normal default browser.
config.ntranslator.common.useLibreTransl: If enabled, NEXEL keeps using LibreTranslate exactly as before. If disabled, NEXEL switches to Google Translate and only replaces the ... placeholder after the full sentence is finished.
config.ntranslator.common.batchTranslate: To avoid stressing the translation instances, NEXEL sends translations at a fixed interval, which also helps avoid redundant requests.
config.ntranslator.common.offloadServers: Additional translation servers running LibreTranslate for reducing strain on your computer.
The URL to a LibreTranslate server.
The API key for the LibreTranslate server. May be blank.
config.ntranslator.common.shouldRunTrans: Should NEXEL automatically start a local LibreTranslate server?
config.ntranslator.common.libreTranslate:
Defines how many threads should be used for the local LibreTranslate server. You'd want to set this to be as high as possible, however you'd also want to leave enough for your operating system and your programs.

Do not modify this if you don't understand what it means.
Should the local LibreTranslate server utilize CUDA for accelerated translations? Only supports NVIDIA GTX 900 graphics cards or newer, any older graphics cards or different vendors may not be supported.
config.ntranslator.common.translatePrior: In which order should be used for prioritizing translating. The top is the highest priority, while the bottom is the lowest priority. If an option is unavailable, it will simply be skipped. This is used to reduce as much strain as possible for all devices in translating.

Performs the translations on the client-side, using the client's graphics card.
Bring this option to a lower priority if it is causing problems to your gameplay experience.

Only supports NVIDIA GTX 900 graphics cards or newer, any older graphics cards or different vendors may not be supported.

Performs the translations on the client-side, using the client's CPU.

May cause your computer to run slower during the translation process if you have a weak CPU.

Bring this option to a lower priority if it is causing problems to your gameplay experience.

Performs the translations on the server-side, using the server's graphics card.

This is the best performing option overall, however is the least supported option due to most dedicated server hosts not providing a graphics card to their servers.

Only supports NVIDIA GTX 900 graphics cards or newer, any older graphics cards or different vendors may not be supported.

Performs the translations on the server-side, using the server's CPU.
May cause the Minecraft server to run slower while performing the translations.

Bring this option to a lower priority if it is causing problems to your gameplay experience.

Performs the translations on a dedicated translation server.

May have more delayed translation times due to a potentially higher traffic of users, but has the least amount of strain on the client and server.

ntranslator.transcriber.browser.title: NEXEL Browser Transcription
ntranslator.transcriber.browser.info: This page captures what you say locally and sends finished phrases to NEXEL only after punctuation or the end of a spoken segment. It keeps the same recognition flow, while avoiding cut or partial translations.
ntranslator.transcriber.browser.paused.d: This usually means the transcription crashed or the game was closed.$BR$If you are still using Browser Transcription in NEXEL, refresh this page and try again.
